E0319

`` `step` `` is not allowed in a range arm — range arms test a band, not a sequence.

What

`` `step` `` is not allowed in a range arm — range arms test a band, not a sequence.

Why

A stride modifies a loop range to skip values (`loop i in 0..10, 2`); an arm head like `1..10` just checks whether the subject is between 1 and 10. A stepped range is not a contiguous band and can't be used for membership testing.

Fix

remove the stride; to match only multiples of N, use a full condition: `subject >= lo && subject <= hi && subject % n == 0 ->`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0319: tests/ui/range_arm_step.stderr.

Error [E0319]: `step` is not allowed in a range arm — range arms test a band, not a sequence
  --> tests/ui/range_arm_step.jet:4:9
    |
  4 |         0..10 step 2 -> { return "even-ish" }
    |         ^^^^^
 Why: `step` is a retired loop spelling; a range arm just checks if the subject falls between the two ends
 Fix: remove `step …`, or use a full condition: `subject >= 0 && subject <= 10 && subject % n == 0 ->`
